What typically happens in India is that when a political party knows they are likely to lose, they start promising big amounts of money, 

knowing that it will help them get some votes, 

but because they will lose regardless, they will not have to worry about making good on those promises

This is a time tested strategy

This strategy works well enough that you can go from 25% to 35% by simply announcing that you will give away a ton of money it you win  

And at the same time, it pressures the other side to also announce a freebie, and they will need to actually pay it, because they are going to win

candidates.text:
Most e-commerce brands mess up Black Friday Cyber Monday because they treat it like a 4-day design contest instead of an offer-driven sprint

If you want to maximize revenue during BFCM without destroying your profit margins or deliverability here is the exact framework to run:

1. Pitch the Offer not the Graphics

Your subscribers inboxes will be flooded with hundreds of flashy HTML emails

The brands that win do not win on banner design

They win on offer clarity

- Use simple text-led or minimal HTML layouts
- Make the discount or bundle deal crystal clear in the first 2 lines
- If your offer does not convert in plain text pretty visuals will not save it

2. The 4-Stage Email Sequence

- VIP Teaser (7 Days Out): Give your most engaged segment early access which builds momentum and tests your checkout flows before peak traffic
- Launch Day (BF Morning): Clear direct announcement sharing what the deal is and what the bestsellers are and where to click
- Mid-Sale Bump (Saturday and Sunday): Switch the angle to focus on customer reviews or social proof or a FAQ objection killer
- Cyber Monday Last Call: Run a countdown format because urgency drives the highest click-through rates of the entire weekend

3. Protect Your Deliverability Early

Do not wait until Black Friday morning to send a blast to 100k unengaged leads

- Aggressively clean your list 30 days prior
- Segment aggressively by sending high-frequency emails ONLY to engaged subscribers who opened or clicked in the last 60 to 90 days
- Keep dead leads out of the main drop to ensure you stay in the Primary inbox

4. Own Your Positioning

Do not be afraid of heavy discounting if that fits your business model Brands like True Classic scale past $500M running deep promo cuts because they own their value lane

Know your market positioning and make the offer irresistible and keep friction to purchase as close to zero as possible

BFCM is not about complex automation decision trees It is about an undeniable offer and clean deliverability and relentless execution
